forward_earnings_policy.rule: Current and next-year consensus are an input to normalized earnings, not the final earnings anchor. At late-cycle or normalization risk, consensus must be normalized against a long-window neutral commodity/cost level before any low-risk price band is produced.

neutral_commodity_policy.rule: For resource companies, compare current revenue-price and input-cost anchors with an approximately two-year neutral median when available. A single high-price year must not redefine the neutral commodity level. Commodity windfall already embedded in consensus can only reduce normalized earnings; weak current commodity conditions do not mechanically increase the low-risk earnings base.

short_term_anchor_policy.rule: Current/MA60 strength is a short-term diagnostic. Negative deterioration may lower the low-risk earnings base, but positive short-term commodity strength cannot lift the low-risk buy zone because that would chase the commodity cycle upward.

low_risk_price_calibration.rule: The stock's own bounded 180-session adjusted close distribution is a calibration constraint, not an intrinsic-value model. The safety zone is anchored to the extreme lower-cost decile of the last 180 sessions; the reasonable zone begins at P10 and may extend toward the middle distribution, but its upper boundary is capped by both normalized fundamental fair value and MA60 plus a small tolerance. This prevents analyst EPS and rising futures prices from mechanically dragging low-risk entry prices upward.

601899.name: 紫金矿业
601899.rationale: Gold and copper diversification supports earnings quality, but low-risk pricing must normalize current gold/copper windfall first and then be checked against the stock's own 180-session market-cost distribution.

601600.name: 中国铝业
601600.rationale: 原铝板块为主要利润弹性来源，氧化铝同时是业务与成本变量；高利润阶段必须先还原中性铝价/氧化铝成本下的盈利，再用2027供给恢复风险与180日价格分布约束低风险买入区。

000807.name: 云铝股份
000807.rationale: 低成本水电铝与一体化优势支持相对溢价，但中东复产、库存重建和需求正常化风险意味着不能把当前高吨铝利润永久资本化；低风险买点还必须接受180日价格中枢校准。

scenario_rules.rule: Scenario EPS starts from calendar-weighted consensus, removes commodity windfall versus a long-window neutral anchor, applies the reviewed 6-18m regime, and allows only negative short-term commodity deterioration to lower low-risk pricing. Bear/base/bull theoretical fair values are diagnostics and are not themselves buy zones.
